differences.current_text: PAUL, a legate of Yeshua the Messiah by the pleasure of God, to them who are at Ephesus, sanctified, and believing in Yeshua the Messiah:
differences.source_text: PAUL, a legate of Jesus the Messiah by the pleasure of God, to them who are at Ephesus, sanctified, and believing in Jesus the Messiah:

differences.current_text: Peace be with you, and grace from God our Father, and from our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: Peace be with you, and grace from God our Father, and from our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: Blessed be God, the Father of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, who hath blessed us with all blessings of the Spirit in heaven, by the Messiah:
differences.source_text: Blessed be God, the Father of our Lord Jesus the Messiah, who hath blessed us with all blessings of the Spirit in heaven, by the Messiah:

differences.current_text: and adopted us for sons, in Yeshua the Messiah, as was agreeable to his pleasure:
differences.source_text: and adopted us for sons, in Jesus the Messiah, as was agreeable to his pleasure:

differences.current_text: Therefore, lo I also, since I heard of your faith in our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, and of your love towards all the saints,
differences.source_text: Therefore, lo I also, since I heard of your faith in our Lord Jesus the Messiah, and of your love towards all the saints,

differences.current_text: that the God of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah, the Father of glory, may give to you the Spirit of wisdom and of revelation, in the recognition of him;
differences.source_text: that the God of our Lord Jesus the Messiah, the Father of glory, may give to you the Spirit of wisdom and of revelation, in the recognition of him;

differences.current_text: and resuscitated us with him, and seated us with him in heaven, in Yeshua the Messiah:
differences.source_text: and resuscitated us with him, and seated us with him in heaven, in Jesus the Messiah:

differences.current_text: that he might show to the coming ages the magnitude of the riches of his grace, and his benignity towards us in Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: that he might show to the coming ages the magnitude of the riches of his grace, and his benignity towards us in Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: For we are his creation ; who are created in Yeshua the Messiah, for good works, which God hath before prepared for us to walk in.
differences.source_text: For we are his creation ; who are created in Jesus the Messiah, for good works, which God hath before prepared for us to walk in.

differences.current_text: But now, by Yeshua the Messiah, ye who before were afar off, have been brought near by the blood of the Messiah.
differences.source_text: But now, by Jesus the Messiah, ye who before were afar off, have been brought near by the blood of the Messiah.

differences.current_text: And ye are built upon the foundations of the legates and the prophets; and Yeshua the Messiah hath become the head of the corner in the edifice.
differences.source_text: And ye are built upon the foundations of the legates and the prophets; and Jesus the Messiah hath become the head of the corner in the edifice.

differences.current_text: On this account, I Paul am a prisoner of Yeshua the Messiah, for the sake of you Gentiles:
differences.source_text: On this account, I Paul am a prisoner of Jesus the Messiah, for the sake of you Gentiles:

differences.current_text: which wisdom he arranged ages before, and he hath executed it by Yeshua the Messiah our Lord;
differences.source_text: which wisdom he arranged ages before, and he hath executed it by Jesus the Messiah our Lord;

differences.current_text: And I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah,
differences.source_text: And I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus the Messiah,

differences.current_text: to him be glory, in his church, by Yeshua the Messiah, in all generations, for ever and ever. Amen.
differences.source_text: to him be glory, in his church, by Jesus the Messiah, in all generations, for ever and ever. Amen.

differences.current_text: if ye have truly heard him, and by him have learned as the truth is in Yeshua.
differences.source_text: if ye have truly heard him, and by him have learned as the truth is in Jesus.

differences.current_text: And give thanks to God the Father, at all times, for all men, in the name of our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: And give thanks to God the Father, at all times, for all men, in the name of our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: Peace be with the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father, and from our Lord Yeshua the Messiah.
differences.source_text: Peace be with the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father, and from our Lord Jesus the Messiah.

differences.current_text: Grace be with all them who love our Lord Yeshua the Messiah without corruptness. Amen.
differences.source_text: Grace be with all them who love our Lord Jesus the Messiah without corruptness. Amen.
